multi_entity_note: A single purchase transaction between one merchant and one customer.

receipt.total_price.rationale: "Total 26.250" is the payable total; the same figure after "Subtotal" plays the subtotal role.

receipt.subtotal_price.rationale: "Subtotal 26.250" is the subtotal; the identical figure after "Total" is the total.

receipt.tax_price.rationale: The tax line "Pajak -" states the tax as a dash (no tax charged); the other dash is inside "GO-PAY".

receipt.cashprice.rationale: Payment was by GO-PAY; no cash amount handed over is stated.
